title: Weighted Dijoin Packing in One-Edge Deletions of Chordal Digraphs and Six-Terminal Single-Defect Digraphs
decided_scope: Weighted dijoin packing nu(D,w)=tau(D,w) for all one-fill chordal digraphs and all 6-terminal one-defect digraphs, plus quotient-rank >= 5 lower bound on minimal missing-color configurations
open_boundaries: Unrestricted Woodall's conjecture for general digraphs
